d: In this episode of Tarikh, we explore the extraordinary life and struggles of Pandit Chhannulal Mishra, the legendary classical vocalist of Banaras. From surviving on roti and tamarind chutney to facing extreme poverty and an 18-year court battle, this is the inspiring story of a musical maestro who defined the soul of Banaras. Discover the iconic moment he received the Padma Bhushan while carrying a flour canister, and how he turned every hardship into a timeless melody. Watch this episode for a heartfelt tribute to the legendary singer who dedicated his entire life to the divine world of…
